notes.title: Undusted: Letters from the Past is Coming on October 13th!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/3eee2b8e058ad197f0d570c66b265a3ac5feb3a4.png

🌻Hello, everyone!

We hope you are doing well! As we mentioned in the previous Steam announcement, we will announce the release date real soon. Today, we’re excited to finally share it with you! 

Undusted: Letters from the Past will be coming to Steam on October 13, 2025

Check out the release date trailer here!
[previewyoutube=cM9Qrs3i8Lw;full][/previewyoutube]


A short message from us 💌
With the release just around the corner, our game director, producer, and lead artist, Yoonjeong Choi, wanted to share a few heartfelt words with you!

“I feel both excited and nervous. My biggest hope is that those who have been waiting for Undusted won’t be let down, and that it can be a game where many people find comfort and joy. We put a lot of effort into making every interaction, especially the sound design, deeply satisfying. If you play while paying attention to the sounds, I think you’ll enjoy it even more.

“And unlike other cleaning games, Undusted blends objects and narrative very closely together. As you clean, the story naturally unfolds, so players who enjoy emotional storytelling will likely find it a meaningful experience.

“Since we first opened Undusted’s Steam store page, people have continuously discovered the game, played the demo, and shared their feedback. Those reactions have had a huge influence on development, and we’re truly grateful for that, and I hope we can give back with a game that feels truly worthwhile.”

If you haven’t tried it yet, the demo is available! ✨
Try the Undusted: Letters from the Past demo while you wait for the full release. Cozy up, relax, and join Adora as she cleans, restores, and polishes cherished objects from her past. 

Play the demo now and wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891020/Undusted_Letters_from_the_Past/

Once again, thank you so much for your support.
We’ll see you soon on the launch day!

Follow us on social media!
🐦 Undusted: Letters from the Past on X (formerly Twitter)
📷Undusted: Letters from the Past on Instagram

Join the community!

notes.title: Demo Update! - Includes a New Item and Other Small Changes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/c12cecaf730144fda5d35172efef83396cff326a.png

Hello, everyone! How have you been?  
We've been spending a lot of time making more things dirty! 
We can't wait to introduce you to these new items soon!

We’ve updated our demo as part of the Wholesome Games Celebration! 
By visiting the Wholesome Games Celebration link, you can discover cozy games on sale and explore new releases!

Now, let’s go over what’s changed in the demo!

Key New Features

A New Item Has Been Added!

 What is this shiny little object? Find out in the demo!

Cleaning Toggle Mode Added

 Tired of sore wrists? With this new feature, you can clean items much more comfortably.
 Now, after pressing the left mouse button, you only need to move the mouse to clean, without holding down the button.
 Enable the Cleaning Toggle Mode in the settings!

Increased Hold Time for Tapping

 We heard your feedback about the inconvenience of constant tapping, so we’ve extended the hold time.
 Also, we’ve removed the annoying tapping sound that was hurting your ears.


Miscellaneous Tweaks

Bug Report Feature Added

 You can now report bugs directly from the settings menu when you encounter issues.
 This helps us understand exactly when and where problems occur, making the game even better with your help!

Warning for PCs Not Meeting Minimum Specs

 We’ve added a warning message in the bottom left corner for computers that do not meet the minimum requirements.

Tool Sound Effects Updated

 We’ve changed the sound effects for the tools.

Improved Cleaning Efficiency

 Reduced the number of hard-to-clean areas on cups with the sponge.
 Sponge Adjustments: The sponge is now smaller but cleans a larger area.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where objects would start clean on some computers.
 Fixed the Bug Where the Percentage Wouldn’t Increase
 Resolved the Issue Where the Sponge Polygon Would Crumple


We Need Your Help!

Is the Bug Still Occurring After the Patch?

 Let us know in the community’s new Demo Bug Report thread!
 It’s even better if you submit a bug report along with your post.
 Link: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2891020/discussions/0/6149188575098876201/


What’s Bothering You? Share Your Thoughts!

 This demo update was developed based on the feedback you left in the community.
 Is there still something that bothers you in the game? Let us know what it is.
 Share your feedback in the community’s new Demo Feedback thread.
 Link: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2891020/discussions/0/6149188575098877233/


Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Undusted: Letters from the Past Demo Build Now Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/169679fea7215f6fa5f4f4e49fd1dceff414841c.png
Hello! This is the development team of Undusted: Letters from the Past.
We are excited to share the first demo of our game with you. You can download and play the demo build from the Steam store page.

📌About the Game

Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game where you clean and restore dirty objects. While developing the game, we focused on providing the following experiences:

1. Gameplay: Mechanically, Visually, and Audibly Satisfying Core Gameplay

The core gameplay revolves around cleaning dirty objects using various methods and tools.
We aim to make this process engaging without being too tedious, repetitive, or overly difficult.
We want players to look forward to discovering diverse objects and learning new interactions and tools needed to restore them as the game progresses.

2. Story: Small but Engaging and Touching Narratives

Our goal is to deliver stories that, while not grand or epic, are heartfelt and touching.
We hope players will be curious about the stories behind each object and imagine how these objects connect to the progression of the narrative.


📌About the Demo Build

In the demo build, you can experience some of the objects and mechanics featured in the game. 
We hope you enjoy it! 
We would love to hear your thoughts on the game, so please share your feedback in the community.

Thank you!
